title: Business Central Functional Consultant
description: Master Business Central from a functional perspective. Learn company setup, licensing, finance, sales, purchasing, and manufacturing — aligned with the MB-800 certification path.
shortDescription: Functional BC skills: setup, finance, sales, purchasing, and manufacturing.
learningOutcomes: Create and configure Business Central companies
Understand BC licensing tiers and module availability
Process customer payments and credit memos
Set up recurring sales and purchase lines
Configure manufacturing master data and item planning
prerequisites: Familiarity with business processes (sales, purchasing, finance)

modules.title: Core Setup & Licensing
modules.description: Company creation, environments, and Business Central licensing models.

modules.title: Financial Management
modules.description: Customer payments, cash flow, and financial operations.

modules.title: Sales & Purchasing
modules.description: Credit memos, recurring lines, and document workflows.

modules.title: Manufacturing & Planning
modules.description: BOMs, routings, production orders, and item planning parameters.
